cadenas.base_en: ▸ Order of use: restaurant → areas → cash. Each file covers one level: the restaurant file marks the MILESTONE (power up, open, close), the areas file details HOW it gets done in each zone, and the cash file tracks the MONEY. If a task shows up in two, that is on purpose: one is the milestone and the other the detail.
